annotation.emotional_arc: quiet grief to silent acceptance and understanding

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: A tiny, singular expression of human grief or emotion (a tear) carries a depth of feeling as vast and profound as the deepest ocean.
acceptable_visual_variants: A single tear falling against a dark, deep blue background that evokes the vastness of the deep sea.
A close-up of a tear on a cheek, with the reflection of a vast, calm ocean horizon visible within the curve of the droplet.
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: A single physical droplet of tear physically reaches down to touch the bottom of the sea.
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Showing a literal droplet of water falling into a physical blue ocean and hitting the seabed, which misses the emotional scale of human grief.
metaphor_spans.source_span_original:
आँसू की एक बूँद,
सागर की गहराई को छूती है।
metaphor_spans.source_span_translation:
A drop of tear,
Touches the depth of the ocean.
metaphor_spans.source_term:
आँसू की एक बूँद,
सागर की गहराई को छूती है।
metaphor_spans.tenor: The profound, immense depth of emotion contained within a single tear.
metaphor_spans.vehicle: A single droplet of water touching the vast, deep floor of an ocean.
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a close-up of a single tear falling, with a subtle, vast ocean-like depth or deep blue abyss reflected inside the droplet itself.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation 'A drop of tear' is slightly unnatural in English compared to the simple, poignant Hindi 'आँसू की एक बूँद' (literally, 'a single drop of tear').
The grammatical gender agreement in Hindi ('बहती है' and 'डूबती है' matching the feminine noun 'बूँद') is lost in the gender-neutral English verbs 'flows' and 'sinks'.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: Every tear shed communicates a deep, unspoken narrative of personal pain and experience without needing spoken words.
acceptable_visual_variants: A sequence of falling tears fading into faint, ghostly outlines of expressive hands or faces, symbolizing a silent narrative.
A single tear resting on a surface, reflecting a soft, warm light that hints at a hidden memory.
metaphor_spans.literal_meaning: Each physical droplet of tear possesses a voice and speaks a literal narrative aloud.
metaphor_spans.literalization_risk: Depicting a cartoonish tear droplet with a mouth speaking words or holding a book, which ruins the somber, reflective tone of the poem.
metaphor_spans.source_span_original:
आँसू की हर बूँद,
कहानी कह जाती है।
metaphor_spans.source_span_translation:
Every drop of tear,
Tells a story well.
metaphor_spans.source_term:
आँसू की हर बूँद,
कहानी कह जाती है।
metaphor_spans.tenor: The expressive power of tears to reveal a person's inner sorrow and history.
metaphor_spans.vehicle: A storyteller speaking or narrating a tale.
metaphor_spans.visualization_strategy: Depict a trail of tears on a face, where each droplet subtly reflects a faint, abstract silhouette of a memory or a past scene, suggesting a history within the water.

translation_loss.what_was_lost: The translation adds the word 'well' to force a rhyme with 'tell', which is not present in the original Hindi text ('कह जाती है' simply means 'goes on to tell' or 'tells').

annotation.theme: The silent but profound depth of human sorrow expressed through tears

original_poem:
आँसू की एक बूँद,  
सागर की गहराई को छूती है।  
कभी चुपके से बहती है,  
कभी गहराई में डूबती है।  

इस दिल के दर्द को,  
कहने की ज़रूरत नहीं।  
आँसू की हर बूँद,  
कहानी कह जाती है।
translated_poem:
A drop of tear,  
Touches the depth of the ocean.  
Sometimes it flows quietly,  
Sometimes it sinks deep.  

This heart's pain,  
Needs no words to tell.  
Every drop of tear,  
Tells a story well.
